dz: "伯威克条约"由英格兰和苏格兰圣公会的领主签署,规定了允许英国武装部队在苏格兰驱逐占领法国军队的条件.
de: The Treaty of Berwick is signed by England and the Lords of the Congregation of Scotland, establishing the terms under which English armed forces were to be permitted in Scotland in order to expel occupying French troops.

dz: 奥斯曼海军在杰尔巴战役中给一支西班牙舰队以惨败. 这标志着奥斯曼海军在地中海的优势地位,在五年后对马耳他的围困失败后,这一优势开始下降.
de: The Ottoman naval forces inflict a defeat on a Spanish fleet in the battle of Djerba. This marks the highpoint of Ottoman naval dominance in the Mediterranean, which starts declining five years later after the failed siege of Malta.

t: 爱丁堡条约由苏格兰和英格兰签署.
te: The Treaty of Edinburgh is signed by Scotland and England.
dz: 爱丁堡条约由苏格兰和英格兰签署.
de: The Treaty of Edinburgh is signed by Scotland and England.

t: 天主教会被推翻，新教被确立为苏格兰的国教。
te: The Catholic Church is overthrown and Protestantism is established as the national religion in Scotland.
dz: 天主教会被推翻，新教被确立为苏格兰的国教。
de: The Catholic Church is overthrown and Protestantism is established as the national religion in Scotland.

t: 十岁的查理九世成为了法国国王,由太后凯瑟琳·德·美第奇出任摄政.
te: Ten-year-old Charles IX becomes king of France, with Queen Mother Catherine de' Medici as regent.
dz: 十岁的查理九世成为了法国国王,由太后凯瑟琳·德·美第奇出任摄政.
de: Ten-year-old Charles IX becomes king of France, with Queen Mother Catherine de' Medici as regent.
